document_questions.question: each page is a separate component (a different project's document); the reviewer to rule whether page-level labels of one compilation file count as one document
document_questions.ruling: one document for the gate, page-level truth for scoring
document_questions.reason: Convention 1 makes each staged file the unit and labels pages 1-4 page by page; F035 is one file, so it counts once per field. Each page is a different project's submittal (EMAAR/Mirage, Emarat/Al Burj, Expo/MUSE, DHA/Hosmac), so there is no single document-level identity, revision or decision: a prediction must be scored against the page it cites, and a document-level answer cannot be scored against F035 as a whole.

proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: An evidence string 'render F###-pN.png' is read as the bare render name and resolves to C:/t/r2x/r32-stage/renders/F###-pN.png; it is valid evidence. Normalise to the bare name in the reviewed version. Where a crop for the same region exists the reviewed version may cite it as well, but a render-only citation is not an error.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (d) Ajman Civil Defence initial / conditional approval (F038)
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: An authority approval that is (i) subject only to standard, printed or generic conditions (fees, use licensed firms, approved materials, submit execution drawings later) or (ii) explicitly an initial/preliminary-stage approval ('Initial Drawings Approval', 'اعتماد مخطط هندسي أولي') is class 'approved'. The stage is recorded in the note (e.g. 'initial approval, not for execution'), not in the class. 'approved as noted' is reserved for approvals carrying comments specific to the reviewed document. Where a third-party consultancy's pre-check stamp (e.g. AJ Training & Consultancy 'APPROVED WITH COMMENTS') and the authority's decision are both on the sheet, the authority decision is the field and the other is noted.
proposed_convention_rulings.evidence: F038 p1 letter: 'تم اعتماد المخططات من قبلنا و لا مانع لدينا من تنفيذ هذه الأعمال شريطة التقيد بالتالي' + generic bullets; p2-p4 blue stamp 'إعتماد مخططات أولية / Initial Drawings Approval' with four printed conditions, red 2020-4-1072822 and 15 Mar 2020; p2 also AJ Training & Consultancy 'APPROVED WITH COMMENTS' 11 MAR 2020.

proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: A code letter is classed by the legend wording printed on the same page, never by the letter alone. Without a legend on the page, follow convention 5 (D = rejected / not approved). Where the page legend gives D another meaning, class by that meaning: 'D - Deferment' (F035 p2 form) is 'other' (deferred, no decision), not rejected and not revise and resubmit. A layout helper must not hard-map D.
